title: research-os experiment post
description: The (Question, Setup, Result, Analysis) write-up of an experiment. Rendered as post.md (a markdown body with these sections) carrying this structured object as YAML frontmatter. capture_results promotes a distilled copy into wiki/sources/exp-{exp_id}.md (source_type: experiment), a citable note that embeds the figures.

question.description: The hypothesis / question the experiment tests.

setup.description: How the experiment is set up to answer the question (design, baselines, conditions).

result.description: What was observed, referencing key_metrics and figures.

analysis.description: Interpretation: what it means for the hypothesis, caveats, limitations.

path.description: Relative path to the figure image.

relates_to.description: Source/page references this finding supports, contradicts, or refines. Drives the graph edge from the experiment node into prior knowledge.

target.description: A wiki source id or page reference (e.g. src:...).
